purpose: Current derived control for every source-identified judge, magistrate, LAJ, Fiscal/prosecutor and canonical court or prosecution institution, without creating a competing identity registry.

person_sources.scope: Source-identified La Laguna and directly linked judicial-cooperation judges and LAJs added after the finite census
Historic Arrecife/AP Las Palmas judges newly source-identified from primary judicial copies on 2-Sep-2026

court_hierarchy.rule: A parent court, each section or court position, every proceeding and every named office-holder remain separate canonical objects. A parent-child court link never transfers handling, knowledge, authorship, panel formation, merits or outcome.

completion_rule: The current derived 62-person denominator is complete only for the presently registered source-identified people. No global all-historic/all-current completeness statement is permitted until every applicable Master Proceedings Register row has populated authority coverage or an explicit source-defined gap and the certified complete docket denominator is closed.

accepted_query_classes: typed caret identifier such as ^P-0147 or ^I-0044
numeric caret shorthand such as ^0147 or ^0044

open_global_gap: Historic and current official dockets have not all been certified complete. Unknown applicable judges, LAJs or Fiscals must remain explicit source gaps and may not be inferred from later office-holders, office leadership, recurring signatures or institutional proximity.
